Do not store sensitive authentication data, such as passwords or session tokens, in unencrypted SharedPreferences; use EncryptedSharedPreferences or the Android Keystore system instead.
Ensure all exported ContentProviders implement strict access controls or signature-level permissions to prevent unauthorized applications from querying private app data.
Validate the calling identity and authorization level in ContentProvider query methods before returning sensitive information in database cursors.
Avoid requesting broad shared external storage permissions unless strictly necessary; prefer scoped storage or app-specific private directories for file operations.
Disable JavaScript in WebViews unless explicitly required, and validate all loaded URLs to prevent cross-site scripting and unauthorized DOM access.
Never expose credentials or private user details through inter-process communication endpoints without verifying caller identity.
